title: The Galaxy Activity, Torus, and Outflow Survey (GATOS): V. Unveiling PAH survival and resilience in the circumnuclear regions of AGNs with JWST
question: How do AGN illumination, outflows, and host-outflow coupling affect the survival, resilience, and properties of PAH molecules in the nuclear and circumnuclear regions of local AGN?

what.value: Fully reduced ALMA CO(3–2) maps of NGC 5506 and NGC 7172

evidence.quote: For this work, we used the fully reduced CO(3–2) maps of NGC 5506 and NGC 7172 from García-Burillo et al. (2021) and Alonso Herrero et al. (2023).

external_data.citation: García-Burillo et al. (2021) and Alonso Herrero et al. (2023)

what.value: JWST/MIRI MRS extracted spectra of the Orion Bar

evidence.quote: In particular, we use the fully reduced version of the spectra presented in Chown et al. (2023), which are publicly available in webpage 9 of the ERS team PDRs4All.

what.value: Nuclear PAH ratios of NGC 6552, NGC 7319, and NGC 7469, and average SF-ring of NGC 7469

evidence.quote: We also plot the nuclear regions of NGC 6552 (blue square), NGC 7319 (black upper limit) and NGC 7469 (magenta square) from García-Bernete et al. (2022d).

what.value: Average PAH ratios of star-forming regions of NGC 3256

evidence.quote: black and magenta filled stars correspond to the average value of star-forming regions of NGC 3256 (from Rigopoulou et al. 2024) and NGC 7469 (from García-Bernete et al. 2022d).

recipe.goal: Produce spatially resolved emission line and PAH feature maps and match angular resolutions
recipe.method: Fit single Gaussians spaxel-by-spaxel to emission lines using ALUCINE; subtract local continuum and integrate residuals over 6.0–6.5 µm and 11.05–11.6 µm for 6.2 and 11.3 µm PAH maps; convolve higher-resolution maps with a Gaussian PSF and resample pixel sizes to match coarser resolution maps.
key_parameters: PAH integration ranges: 6.0–6.5 µm (6.2 µm band) and 11.05–11.6 µm (11.3 µm band)

recipe.goal: Correlate cold molecular gas, warm molecular gas, and PAH emission spaxel-by-spaxel
recipe.method: Compute Pearson's correlation coefficients spaxel-by-spaxel between 11.3 µm PAH, H2 0-0 S(1) 17.03 µm, and ALMA CO(3–2) intensity maps.

recipe.goal: Extract nuclear and circumnuclear aperture spectra and fit mid-IR PAH features
recipe.method: Extract nuclear point-source spectra (~0.4'' at 11 µm) and circumnuclear circular aperture spectra (1.0'' and 1.5'' diameter); fit PAH bands using modified PAHFIT for circumnuclear/SF regions and a differential extinction model for obscured nuclear spectra; compare 6.2/7.7 and 11.3/7.7 µm PAH ratios with DFT model grids.
key_parameters: Aperture diameters: ~0.4'' at 11 µm (nuclear point source), 1.0'' (SF ring), 1.5'' (outflow, high-velocity dispersion, and galaxy disk regions)
assumptions: Nuclear regions are point sources for spectral extraction
NLR (ionization cones) are co-spatial with the main AGN ionized outflow

score_reason: Public JWST and ALMA archive identifiers and pipeline versions are clearly stated, and measured PAH fluxes are tabulated in the appendix, but exact coordinates for the 25 extraction apertures, custom JWST pixel masking details, and ALMA imaging parameters for NGC 5728 are not provided.
rediscovery_reason: Both JWST MIRI/MRS and ALMA CO(3–2) datasets are publicly available in archives, and the core quantitative results (spaxel-by-spaxel Pearson correlations between PAH, H2 S(1), and CO(3–2), as well as PAH band ratios in nuclear/outflow/SF regions) can be independently re-derived.
